subject: planner: increase tablescan cost for high risk scenarios (#56203)
summary: Reviewed commit a3a451196d vs its parent. The only runtime behavior change is in `pkg/planner/core/plan_cost_ver2.go`: for TiKV `PhysicalTableScan`, it adds an extra scan-cost penalty when the scan is a full-range scan and stats/session conditions indicate high risk of underestimation; TiFlash startup penalty is unchanged aside from constants. Other changes are test expectations/order/hints. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, privilege/visibility, transaction/locking, concurrency, or runtime/protocol handling; the change is confined to optimizer cost modeling and uses safe full-range detection via `ranger.HasFullRange`.
